title: 5.7.4 Lab: Method with parameters
description: Add `Counter.addBy(n)`: a method that takes an argument and uses it to increment `this.n`. Keys 1/2/3 add different amounts.

steps.title: Write the addBy(n) method
steps.instructions: Inside the `Counter` class body, write an `addBy(n)` method that adds the argument `n` to `this.n`. The driver, the code in `draw()` under the class that runs the sketch, already calls `c.addBy(1)`, `c.addBy(2)`, and `c.addBy(3)` on keys 1/2/3: you just need the method.
hints: Open the moSHion docs drawer on the right and review the class method section: methods can declare parameters just like regular functions.

requirements.title: addBy(n) method declared
requirements.description: Write an `addBy(n)` method inside `Counter` that takes a parameter and uses it. Help: 5.7.1 (Methods: functions that live on a class)

requirements.title: Parameter used inside method body
requirements.description: The parameter passed to `addBy` is referenced inside the method body (e.g. `this.n += n`). Help: 3.2.5 (Parameters and Arguments)
